content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC ACTREC Project Co-ordinator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Tata Memorial Centre (TMC ACTREC) located in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra for research projects.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Project Co-ordinator on a contract basis under advertisement number Advt- OS-A/118/2026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Co-ordinator position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for the Project Co-ordinator post?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of a Walk-in Interview where candidates are evaluated based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 07 October 2026 at the designated venue in Navi Mumbai.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate or Post Graduate Degree in Science, Maths, Statistics, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Epidemiology, Population science, or related fields along with a postgraduate diploma or certificate course in cancer research, clinical research, or cancer registry.

faq.question: Q7. Is prior work experience required to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants are required to have a minimum of 03 years of relevant experience in clinical research to be eligible for the post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is set up to 30 years, which may be relaxed based on the candidate's relevant professional experience.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary ranging between ₹ 34,000/- p.m. to ₹ 40,000/- p.m.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry their updated Bio-data, recent passport-size photograph, original and self-attested copies of Aadhar Card, PAN Card, educational mark sheets, certificates, and relevant experience certificates.
